arguments.code: import time, urllib.request, urllib.parse BASE = "http://160.202.254.160:15880/" PROXY = {"http": "http://127.0.0.1:12001", "https": "http://127.0.0.1:12001"} op = urllib.request.build_opener(urllib.request.ProxyHandler(PROXY)) def get(data=None): d = urllib.parse.urlencode(data).encode() if data is not None else None with op.open(BASE, data=d, timeout=20) as r: return r.read().decode("gb18030", "replace") def probe(mark, content): get({"content": mark + content}) time.sleep(0.25) body = get() i = body.find(mark) if i < 0: print(" %-10s (未找到)" % mark); return j = body.find("", i) seg = body[i:j] if j > 0 else body[i:i+200] print(" %-6s IN=%r" % (mark, content)) print(" OUT=%r" % seg[len(mark):]) probe("T1", "[img]A[/img]") probe("T2", "[img]B") probe("T3", "[img]C[img]D[/img]") probe("T4", "[img]E[/img][img]F[/img]") probe("T5", "[/img]G") probe("T6", "[img]Hhttp://i.j[/img]")
